_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json and fill it in. deploy.config.json is gitignored, never commit real credentials. Used by scripts/deploy.mjs (npm run deploy / deploy:nobuild / deploy:dry). Any value can also be supplied as an env var of the same name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (such as FTP_PASSWORD) which takes priority over this file.
_secure: FTPS mode. true = explicit FTPS on port 21 (recommended, Plesk default). "implicit" = implicit FTPS (usually port 990). false = plain unencrypted FTP.
_tlsStrict: Verify FTP TLS certificate. Shared or Plesk hosts often present certificates that do not strictly match the hostname, leave false unless endpoint has a valid certificate.
_remoteDir: Remote directory relative to FTP root. "/" represents web root.
_siteUrl: Public site URL for post deployment verification ping.
